correctness.rationale: Real symmetric Laplacian decomposes into 0 constant vector, radial (m+1)t vector, Fourier rim pairs with eigenvalues t+nu_j, and even Nyquist singleton. Strict monotonicity of nu_j isolates all positive collisions mt=nu_j. PBH restriction to chosen coordinates gives Fourier-pair determinants sin(2*pi*j*d/m), gcd(q,d)=1 and even alternating parity; radial plus resonant double Fourier pair forms a 3-dimensional eigenspace needing 3 controls. Hub+two rim and three rim choices are classified by rank-3 determinant (unit-circle points distinct) and simultaneous Fourier rank-2 gcd constraints. Independent exact SymPy Kalman ranks for m=3,4,6,7 and specified rational weights confirm minimum counts and placement conditions, including m=3 and t=4/m; modular scripts only supply finite corroboration, not proof for irrational weights.
